items.title: Used to be a whale
items.summary:
Decent game, beautiful character designs. Spent so much on this game (probably thousands) and got both limited avatar borders, but the miscommunication, inconsistency and silence from the dev team is putting me off severely. It is becoming more and more common that they make promises and fail to commit and also act very hypocritical. Whatever they intend to do, I just want them to be honest about it, at the very least. I do not intend to spend more till then.

Recent completely insane d-tide buffs have basically wasted the spending I put into characters, and noticeably the difficulty is even HARDER for people who arent extremely high spending. They also changed affinity farming for characters — it takes MUCH longer just to get to ten, and they increased the max to twenty, showcasing that it’d change a characters cards borders to something unique — only for it to he a plain white border, which is an absolute insult. 😭 For anyone new reading this, affinity farming takes around 7500 manual battles for twenty. Yeah, don’t even bother. 

Oh, did I mention the game crashing, and making my phone heat up a lot? I use an Iphone 16 Pro Max, and in one play session (two hours) it will crash like 3-4 times. It has been months and months and the devs has not fixed this or optimized their game for this although they did fix a lagging issue.
